# glat.info

> > Guillaume Lathoud's portfolio of programming tools, research, and optimized computing libraries spanning audio processing, JavaScript compilation, and mathematical algorithms.

glat.info is a developer portfolio showcasing research and open-source projects in signal processing, performance optimization, and compiler design. The site features both practical tools for web development and academic resources for audio-visual research.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Performance Optimization
- Audio Processing
- Signal Processing
- Microphone Arrays
- Speaker Localization
- Linear Algebra
- Matrix Operations
- Code Generation
- Compiler Design
- Discrete Fourier Transform
- Speed Benchmarks
- Guillaume Lathoud
- C/D/Python
- MATLAB

## Audio Processing & Research

- [Online resources for audio processing](http://www.glat.info/ma): Audio processing resources including microphone arrays and speaker localization
- [AV16.3 Audio-Visual Corpus Homepage](http://www.glat.info/ma/av16.3): AV16.3 audio-visual corpus for speaker localization and tracking research
- [Questions and answers about microphone array ressources and Unsupervised Spectral Subtraction](https://glat.info/qa.html): FAQ on microphone arrays, spectral subtraction, and AV16.3 corpus

## JavaScript Performance Libraries

- [Flatorize](http://glat.info/flatorize): Flatorize: JavaScript compiler for optimized flat mathematical expressions
- [Fast explicit tail calls in JavaScript](https://glat.info/fext): Documentation for fext library enabling tail call optimization in JavaScript
- [flatmat.js](http://glat.info/flatorize/lib/flatmat_speedtest.html): flatmat.js performance benchmarks for matrix operations and linear algebra
- [Generate flat expressions for speed](http://glat.info/bpjs2014/index.html): Guide on generating optimized flat expressions for performance using flatorize

## Web Tools & Utilities

- [Hashfiddle](https://glat.info/hafi): Hashfiddle: minimalist web-based code editor with URL hash storage
- [Guillaume Lathoud's page](https://glat.info): Guillaume Lathoud's developer portfolio covering programming languages and tools

## Mathematical Algorithms & Theory

- [Soft Optimal Stop For 99% Guarantee](https://glat.info/sos99): Algorithm for Secretary Problem with 99% worst-case guarantee optimization
- [Circular sets and powers of two](https://glat.info/cipo): Mathematical proof on circular sets and powers-of-two permutations
- [PCR Test aus mathematischer Sicht - Deutschland, 18.12.2020](https://glat.info/pcrt): Mathematical analysis of PCR test accuracy using Bayes' theorem

## Optional

- [Funny things about the number 108](https://glat.info/108): Mathematical curiosities and properties of the number 108
